global_rules.evaluation_unit: one exact manifest-listed safetensors file; model results sum file-level raw bytes, charged archive bytes, and elapsed times

strict_whole_file_accounting.raw_bytes: the complete input file, including the safetensors length word, JSON header, metadata, padding or gaps, tensor payloads, and any trailing bytes
strict_whole_file_accounting.charged_archive_bytes: the sum of every file or byte range that must be retained to restore the input without consulting the original
must_charge: codebooks, dtype and shape tables, offset tables, and framing
a selected pipeline or program description
any input-specific generated artifact required by the decoder
strict_whole_file_accounting.may_exclude: a pinned, input-independent codec executable or library, under the same convention used for gzip, Brevis, and the other baselines
strict_whole_file_accounting.fresh_decode_rule: a fresh process must restore the complete file using only the charged archive and pinned input-independent software
strict_whole_file_accounting.correctness: restored byte length and SHA-256 must equal the manifest-bound input; tensor equality or model-output equality alone is insufficient
strict_whole_file_accounting.expansion_policy: retain and report negative storage saving; never replace an expanded archive with an omitted row

timing.cache_condition: best-effort buffered-cache conditioning, not guaranteed warm-cache and not cold-I/O throughput

coverage.row_policy: emit one row for every preregistered method/profile/model file combination, including failures and inapplicable combinations
coverage.domain_policy: domain-mismatched byte-exact runs remain labeled and are not pooled with in-domain specialized-baseline results

failure_record_requirements: source and executable hashes available before failure

domain_match.unsupported_tensor_policy: store verbatim and charge in full; do not describe I8 or FP8 payloads as natively ZipNN-compressed

profiles.purpose: primary serial specialized baseline using the pinned release's documented safetensors path

requirements: parse tensor spans without rewriting the original safetensors representation
retain every non-tensor byte verbatim
apply ZipNN only to F32, F16, and BF16 tensor payloads
store unsupported tensors and non-beneficial compressed tensors verbatim
charge the wrapper header, per-tensor mode table, ZipNN payloads, and all passthrough bytes
restore original tensor order, offsets, metadata, padding, and trailing bytes
verify exact whole-file SHA-256 in a fresh process
strict_adapter_contract.upstream_script_is_not_sufficient: the pinned safetensors scripts load tensors and call save_file, so tensor equality does not establish byte-identical restoration of the original container

cost_accounting.compression: strict-adapter parse plus ZipNN encoding plus archive write
cost_accounting.decompression: archive read plus ZipNN decoding plus exact original-file materialization
cost_accounting.parallel_scaling: repeat separately with --threads equal to each preregistered worker count

baselines.repeat_policy: use the global tier-specific warmup and measured-repetition schedule after the adapter gate passes

domain_match.classification: BF16 Llama-family weight compression with architecture-specific module patterns
domain_match.reason_for_narrow_scope: the current comparison requires an exact original-input compression path; publisher-precompressed DFloat11 models and unrelated architectures are not substitutes for the pinned TinyLlama file

profile.pattern_dict: must be architecture-specific, frozen in the adapter before the first formal run, and retained verbatim in raw results

requirements: CUDA 12-compatible runtime and PyTorch/CuPy builds
record GPU model, compute capability, driver, CUDA runtime, PyTorch, and CuPy versions
verify the pinned decode.ptx and decode.cu SHA-256 values
load the pinned PTX on the actual evaluation GPU without a PTX-JIT or kernel-image error
decode a deterministic BF16 smoke tensor and compare every output bit
record peak GPU memory and synchronize CUDA around timed decode regions
compress the manifest-bound TinyLlama BF16 file rather than downloading a precompressed replacement
charge every generated safetensors file, DFloat11 table, configuration field, and input-specific sidecar needed for decoding
retain verbatim original container bytes needed to reconstruct the exact safetensors serialization
materialize the original complete file, not merely weights in GPU memory or equivalent model outputs
verify exact whole-file SHA-256 in a fresh process

cost_accounting.offline_compression: record model load, DFloat11 encoding, strict framing, and archive write separately and end to end
cost_accounting.archive_decompression: time exact file materialization for the storage comparison
cost_accounting.on_the_fly_gpu_decode: may be reported as a separate systems metric, never substituted for archive decompression time
cost_accounting.inference: outside the primary storage benchmark unless a separately preregistered inference experiment is added

baselines.repeat_policy: one global medium-tier warmup plus six measured archive operations after both adapter and GPU gates pass; CUDA timing also requires explicit synchronization

hard_gates: complete file size is positive and less than 2147483648 bytes because the pinned CPU programs use int-sized file lengths
complete file size is divisible by 4
domain_match.input_policy: pass the complete safetensors file directly; the header is processed and charged rather than stripped

build.gate: require all CPU outputs even if compile.py itself returns success after an individual compiler failure; record compiler version, full command, and executable SHA-256

environment.OMP_NUM_THREADS: 1 for the primary serial comparison; use the exact requested worker count only in a separately labeled scaling run

baselines.repeat_policy: one warmup plus six measured repetitions on each of the two eligible small-model files for each profile

domain_match.reporting_rule: report out-of-domain rows separately and do not use them to claim a matched floating-point-specialized comparison

build.record: gcc version, exact argv, source SHA-256, and executable SHA-256

baselines.thread_policy: single process with no exposed worker control

strict_adapter_contract.charged_output: every byte written to stdout by the compressor

baselines.repeat_policy: use the global tier-specific schedule on every manifest file, subject to preregistered timeout and resource gates

domain_match.limitation: fpzip targets correlated floating-point arrays and its own README says it is not suitable for unstructured streams; these rows test the two F32 files without implying a spatial-data match

hard_gates: input length equals the preregistered value
precision is exactly 32, never a lossy setting

strict_adapter_contract.charged_output: the complete fpzip stream, including its header

baselines.repeat_policy: one warmup plus six measured repetitions on each eligible small-model file

domain_match.explicit_exclusion: the mixed-I8/BF16 SmolLM and every GB-scale non-F32 entry are dtype/domain mismatches for this preregistered paper-inspired protocol, not resource skips

ga_configuration.component_space: the pinned LC 1.2 lossless component list
ga_configuration.seed_provenance: the AdaptiveFC paper reports nine runs but does not publish the nine seed values; 0 through 8 are newly preregistered Brevis seeds

resource_gate.stage_1: run one seed-0 pilot on each eligible file and retain its complete logs, costs, selected pipeline, and correctness status
resource_gate.stage_2: run all seeds 0 through 8 only if both pilots pass whole-file correctness and the recorded wall-time, memory, and disk budget permits the complete expansion
resource_gate.partial_policy: if expansion stops, retain completed seeds, mark missing seeds skipped_resource with the same threshold, and do not call the subset a nine-seed reproduction

must_record_separately: GA search time and peak RSS for every seed
selected pipeline and its measured objective
archive compression time and peak RSS
archive decompression time and peak RSS
search_and_cost_accounting.end_to_end_compression_time: GA search plus per-input code generation/build plus one archive compression; framework build is also reported and included if it is input-specific
search_and_cost_accounting.steady_state_time: compression or decompression using the already selected pipeline, labeled separately from end to end
search_and_cost_accounting.selection_rule: report every completed seed; do not choose the best seed as the primary result
search_and_cost_accounting.optional_best_of_nine: may appear only as a labeled secondary analysis whose cost includes all nine searches

requirements: search and compress the complete safetensors bytes, including the header
place a complete selected-pipeline description and framing in the charged archive
decode in a fresh process using only the archive and pinned input-independent LC software
if an input-specific generated binary is required and cannot be replaced by an input-independent decoder plus the archived description, include and charge that binary
verify exact restored length and SHA-256

baselines.repeat_policy: GA variability uses the fixed seed protocol; after selection, seed 0's fixed pipeline receives one warmup plus six measured steady-state compression/decompression repetitions, while every completed seed receives at least one full round-trip correctness run

exclusion_reasons: the reported K15 charged-format number is an estimate and was not independently serialized and decoded at GLM scale
the byte-split path validates tensor round trips but does not provide the matched, timed complete-file archive/decompress interface required here
the dense 12-bit GPU prototype does not fuse the sparse exact correction and is not a complete exact serving path
using an estimate or a partial prototype as an observed archive baseline would violate strict whole-file accounting
permitted_use: a seed for future adapter work after a complete exact archive path exists
baselines.result_row_policy: do not emit compression-ratio or timing measurements; preserve this explicit exclusion record
